chunks: For such the abode is only Hell from which they will find no escape.

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (demonstrative pronoun pointing to a specific group)

ai.seo_question: What is the final abode of those described in this verse and can they escape it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the fate of those who reject the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt or fail to uphold the covenant of Wilayah, emphasizing that their punishment is not merely physical but a consequence of spiritual alienation. The phrase 'no escape' (la yajiduna anha mahisan) underscores the finality of divine justice, where no intercession or refuge can avail them against the decree of Allah.
